description: Gameplay footage from Deep Dive 'n' Chill, a dim underwater cave with the game's own rock, kelp and cave-wall art. The player swims up to a floating question-mark block and bumps it from below; it pops open and several coins scatter out into the water around it and the open chasm below.
reproduces: https://github.com/SuperTux/supertux/issues/3729 (both attached clips: a coin-explosion block triggered near/under water, coins sinking straight down instead of floating)
scenario: data/levels/world1/deep_dive_chill.stl, the underwater cave section partway through the level. Tux swims up into the level's own coin-explosion block (the existing 'orange' bonus block at the spot this cut shows, given the content type the issue describes), releasing a burst of heavy coins that fall through the surrounding water.
